ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity (black) background with 30% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution primarily localized in circular formations.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white contiguous patches at both distal tips; dense spatial mapping of high-intensity white circular rings (annuli) across the entirety of both lobes; central area near the notch is primarily solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 82 degrees; bounding-box depth occupies approximately 15-20% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present along the entire continuous trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude variations are most pronounced on the distal thirds of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex curve fitted to both lobe edges, terminating in pointed and irregularly jagged distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive detection of hundreds of circular high-contrast white pixel rings (annular clusters) varying from 5 to 25 pixels in diameter, distributed uniformly across the visible surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, parallel horizontal linear pixel disruptions on the inner right lobe; faint diagonal linear marks breaking the black pigmentation on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive coverage of annular scarring across both lobes; irregular jagged loss of material on the outer margin of the left fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'ringed' texture caused by near-complete coverage of the surface with high-contrast circular markings.
